summary: Preserve explicit anonymous public Travel command wiring, exact dated offer identity, per-room whole-stay quote units, bounded coverage, and live/cache provenance.
reason: Public HTML plan pages contain multiple room tuples per source plan, with explicit uniform per-room party and query echoes; generic endpoint output and compact filtering can erase quote units or silently substitute an offer. Reprints must retain serial bounded comparisons, exact inspection with separately scoped property policies, and content-based live verification.
validated_outcome: CLI tests use the real domain client with injected HTTP transport: 105 source-page rows require one inventory fetch plus two property fetches, prices/IDs survive agent and dotted selection, and empty/error comparison cells retain distinct status. Constructor edges and literal read-only annotations keep source discovery aligned with the runtime command tree. Workflow command text carries flags for the observed runner; acceptance must reject skipped extracted inputs and use live semantic assertions.
